explanations.headline: An unregistered AI agent can act as a full AWS administrator
explanations.risk_explanation: If this agent is manipulated through prompt injection or a compromised tool, it could create users, change permissions, and read any data in the account.
explanations.business_impact: Potential account takeover and exposure of restricted customer exports.
explanations.recommended_next_step: Replace AdministratorAccess with the approved least-privilege policy after owner confirmation.
